first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 shows activation messaging improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to first meaningful action—this directly addresses the activation decline. Memory_86 and memory_31 show onboarding simplification works, but activation_messaging targets the symptom more precisely: accounts may be signing up but failing to engage meaningfully post-signup. This preserves focus on qualified revenue by driving engagement among existing signups rather than chasing price-sensitive accounts (which memory_73 shows works but is reactive to competitor pricing) or referrals (which memory_57 shows works but is secondary to core activation health). Verifying memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude and durability of prior activation and onboarding improvements before committing. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to the current activation and onboarding decline. A standard_experiment on activation_messaging in the product carries lower implementation risk than broad rollout and allows measurement of effect size against the 6% baseline decline.
